meta_description:
134K likes, 792 comments - thebetterindia on April 8, 2025: "“If everyone runs behind cricket, who will play the other sports?” 

In a country where cricket dominates, 20-year-old Shraddha Rangarh from Haryana is landing knockout kicks — and shattering stereotypes.

With no coach, financial support, or family backing, Shraddha taught herself kickboxing through YouTube. Her training ground? Rooftops and fields. Her fuel? Pure determination.

Told that sports weren’t for girls, and raised in a home where even education was a privilege, Shraddha found her own way — saving ₹100 at a time from Navratri Kanjak ceremonies just to enter local tournaments.

What began as a dream became her reality.
- Multiple national gold medals
- Asian and World Cup medals
- 2 Golds + €500 at the Delhi Open International

Now ranked World No. 5, she’s chasing a goal no Indian has achieved yet: Gold at the 2025 World Kickboxing Championship.

“When you’re on the podium and the Indian anthem plays, all the struggle disappears,” she says.

Tap the LINK IN BIO to see how Shraddha fought the odds — and made history!

#ShraddhaRangarh #Kickboxing #WomenInSports #Inspiring #Haryana #2025WorldChampionship
